idea-plugin.name: Opt-Out Signal Lint for US State Privacy Laws
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the ad and analytics code that keeps firing after a visitor’s browser has already sent Global Privacy Control.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Opt-Out Signal Lint for US State Privacy Laws: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 20 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/optout-signal-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/optout-signal-lint
